### We Cannot Out-Give God
Author: Billy Graham
Site: Billy Graham Evangelistic Association
URL: https://billygraham.org/devotions/we-cant-out-give-god
Passage: Leviticus 27:30
Points:
- Believers are called to manage their financial resources faithfully as God's stewards.
- Returning the tithe acknowledges that what we have ultimately belongs to the Lord.
- Investing money into God's kingdom brings genuine blessing rather than loss.
- Real-life testimonies illustrate God's reliable provision for those who give faithfully.
- Scripture assures us that it is impossible to out-give God.
